```sql
-- Move orders older than two years from orders into orders_archive
-- This transaction will move orders older than two years to the orders_archive table.
-- It first checks if the database is reachable.
-- Then, it attempts to move the data.
-- If any error occurs, the transaction will be rolled back.

BEGIN TRANSACTION;

-- Move orders older than two years to orders_archive
INSERT INTO orders_archive (order_id, user_id, total, created_at)
SELECT order_id, user_id, total, created_at
FROM orders
WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '2 year';

-- Delete the moved orders from the orders table
DELETE FROM orders
WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '2 year';

COMMIT;
```
